summary: Frontend-only retest of the MODULES toolbar/menu and draggable inner cards on the public URL. MODULES renders fully at 106.56×34 px, all five requested modules open/close, every .prime-card has a visible grab handle, grip dragging changes position, and each tested card restores its position after close/reopen. Primary heading drag and interactive input/checkbox safety pass. Two drag defects remain: LOCUS and HERACLES share the fallback localStorage key, and secondary PANTHEON section headings are not draggable. The HUD has no page errors, but repeated hardcoded localhost WebSocket console errors remain.

ui_bugs.component: PANTHEON cards with multiple section headings
ui_bugs.issue: Only the first .zc-section-title in each .prime-card gets cursor:grab and a pointerdown listener. The secondary TABLEAU DE CONNECTIVITÉ and HISTORIQUE DES CONNEXIONS headings have cursor:auto and dragging them moves the card by 0 px.

integration_issues.issue: LOCUS and HERACLES cards lack data-testid, so both persist under sirius_card_pos_card-0. After moving LOCUS to translate(36px, 24px), opening HERACLES for the first time immediately inherited that position; moving HERACLES then overwrites LOCUS's saved position.

No pageerror or visible error was found, but 18 console errors were captured during the complete module traversal because the public page repeatedly reconnects to ws://localhost:8765 and receives net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED.

action_items: Namespace each storage key by module/root test id, or add unique data-testid values to the LOCUS and HERACLES .prime-card elements so they cannot share sirius_card_pos_card-0.
Attach drag behavior and cursor:grab to every matching section heading in a card (querySelectorAll), not only querySelector's first match.
Replace or disable the hardcoded ws://localhost:8765 connection for the public deployment so the no-console-errors regression criterion passes.
Clean up useDraggableCards.js lint failures (two empty catch blocks and one unused eslint-disable directive).
critical_code_review_comments: useDraggableCards.js line 15 derives fallback keys only from card index. Without a module namespace, independently rendered modules collide whenever their cards omit data-testid; this was reproduced between LOCUS and HERACLES.

useDraggableCards.js line 69 uses card.querySelector(...), so cards containing multiple .zc-section-title nodes wire only the first heading. Use querySelectorAll and register/clean up each heading listener.
App.js still hardcodes WS_URL='ws://localhost:8765', producing repeated errors on the HTTPS public deployment.
ESLint on useDraggableCards.js reports two no-empty errors and one unused eslint-disable warning; the new hook does not currently pass lint.

success_rate.frontend: 85% — core layout, menu, all 5 grip drags, close/reopen persistence, primary heading drag, and interactive controls pass; key isolation, all-heading drag, and clean console regressions fail

seed_data_creation: No backend seed data. Browser localStorage was cleared and populated only with a temporary Testeur profile; drag keys were created in the isolated browser context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest PANTHEON's second heading in pantheon-notifications and pantheon-connectivity, not only the first title. Then drag LOCUS, open HERACLES before dragging it, and assert HERACLES starts with an empty transform and uses a different localStorage key. Core grip dragging passed for ORACLE, PANTHEON, LOCUS, HERACLES, and ARGUS at 1920x1080.
rca_of_the_issue: Heading defect: the hook selects one heading per card with querySelector, leaving later .zc-section-title nodes unwired. Persistence defect: key construction uses card data-testid or card-{index}; LOCUS and HERACLES cards have no data-testid and each is index 0, so both resolve to sirius_card_pos_card-0. Console defect: App.js opens a localhost-only WebSocket unconditionally on the public HTTPS site and retries with backoff.
